tasks.objective: Load the complete authorized snapshot of MYSQL_SHOW_PROCESSLIST from the delivered dataset. After loading all rows into memory, call time.sleep(25). Then compute aggregate counts: (1) total_connections = total number of processlist rows in this snapshot; (2) sleep_connections = count of rows where the Command field equals exactly 'Sleep' (case-sensitive). Write exactly one JSONL row to rows.jsonl with fields total_connections (integer) and sleep_connections (integer). Do not emit any raw source record values, identifiers, or SQL text. Only output the aggregate counts.
